column1: # The static analysis's accepted findings (P15-TSK-006; infra/scripts/sast.sh; infra/semgrep/baseline.py).
# fingerprint <TAB> rule <TAB> path <TAB> excerpt <TAB> until <TAB> reason
# One row per finding, so two findings with the same text in one file take two rows. The fingerprint covers the rule, the
# file and the matched text, so a row survives a line moving and stops matching the moment the text changes: a changed
# statement is looked at again, and a row that matches nothing, or is past its date, fails the job. Every row is a
# read site or a statement read by a person on 2026-11-08, whose reason says what makes it safe or what it is carried
# for, and the set is counted in THREAT_MODEL.md section 6 item 12. SecurityScansAreWiredTest holds every row to having
# a real rule, a real file, a reason and an unexpired date, and the whole to a fraction of the tree's statements.
